scripts.dev: npm run prepare:assets && npm run pages && vite --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.build: npm run prepare:assets && npm run pages && vite build
scripts.lint: eslint src site tests scripts vite.config.js eslint.config.js --max-warnings=0
scripts.format: prettier --write src/*.{js,jsx} src/tools/*.{js,jsx} site/*.mjs tests/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs vite.config.js eslint.config.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src/*.{js,jsx} src/tools/*.{js,jsx} site/*.mjs tests/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs vite.config.js eslint.config.js
